io.name: clk
io.description: Clock. All state updates occur on the positive edge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Active-high synchronous reset. When asserted at a positive clock edge, all out bits are cleared to 0.

io.name: in
io.description: 32-bit input vector sampled on each positive clock edge.

io.name: out
io.description: 32-bit output vector. Bit i is set to 1 when in[i] transitions from 1 to 0 between consecutive sampled clock edges, and remains 1 until reset.

functional_summary.overview: Detects 1-to-0 transitions on each bit of a 32-bit input across consecutive positive clock edges. When in[i] is 1 at one sampled edge and 0 at the next, out[i] is set to 1 and held until a synchronous active-high reset clears it. Reset has priority over transition detection.
rules: On each positive clock edge, if reset is 1, out is cleared to 0 (reset dominates).
Otherwise, for each bit i in 0..31: if the previous sampled value of in[i] was 1 and the current sampled value of in[i] is 0, then out[i] becomes 1.
Once out[i] is set to 1, it remains 1 on subsequent edges until reset is asserted, regardless of further input transitions.
Bits of out that are already 1 stay 1 (sticky) unless reset is asserted.
The previous input value is tracked per bit across clock edges; the initial previous value before any edge is treated as 0 (no spurious transition on the first edge).
out is registered and reflects the state after the positive clock edge (latency of 1 cycle from the sampling edge).
